Container.Name: sabthrottle
Container.Overview: Throttles SABnzbd and JDownloader 2 automatically while Jellyfin is actively streaming (e.g. via NZBDav), so streams always have enough bandwidth. While streaming, all downloaders share one bandwidth budget, split demand-based between them. Also supports per-downloader time-based speed profiles (e.g. weekdays 7-17 = 50%, nights = 100%) via a built-in WebUI.
Container.Description: Polls Jellyfin for active playback sessions and adjusts the SABnzbd and JDownloader 2 speed limits dynamically. While at least one stream is active, all downloaders share one bandwidth budget (demand-based split). When all streams end, full speed is restored. Additionally supports per-downloader time-based speed profiles (e.g. weekdays 7-17 = 50%, nights = 100%) configured directly in the built-in WebUI. Rules and settings are persisted to /config so they survive container restarts.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the WebUI and API listen on

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Where rules.json and settings.json are stored.

Config.Name: SABNZBD_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your SABnzbd instance

Config.Name: SABNZBD_API_KEY
Config.Description: SABnzbd API key (Config -> General -> API Key)

Config.Name: STREAM_BUDGET_PERCENT
Config.Description: Initial total download budget (percent of line speed) shared by all downloaders while a Jellyfin stream is active (seeds settings.json on first start; can be changed in the WebUI later)

Config.Name: FULL_PERCENT
Config.Description: Initial default speed limit (percent) when no stream and no rule is active (seeds settings.json on first start; can be changed in the WebUI later)

Config.Name: LINE_SPEED_MBIT
Config.Description: Optional: your real internet line speed in Mbit/s. Used so percent values can be displayed as MB/s and compared with absolute (Mbit/s, MB/s) rules. 0 = unknown.

Config.Name: MYJD_EMAIL
Config.Description: Optional: MyJDownloader account e-mail. Set together with MYJD_PASSWORD and MYJD_DEVICE to also throttle JDownloader 2.

Config.Name: MYJD_DEVICE
Config.Description: Optional: JDownloader device name exactly as shown on my.jdownloader.org.

Config.Name: MYJD_APP_KEY
Config.Description: App identifier used against the MyJDownloader API.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_URL
Config.Description: Optional: Jellyfin base URL. If set together with JELLYFIN_API_KEY, sabthrottle polls Jellyfin directly and the Webhook plugin is not needed.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_API_KEY
Config.Description: Jellyfin API key (Dashboard -> API Keys). Required for polling mode.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_POLL_INTERVAL_SEC
Config.Description: Poll interval in seconds (only used in polling mode)

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional shared secret to authenticate the Jellyfin webhook (only used in webhook mode)

Config.Name: NZBDAV_PATH_PREFIX
Config.Description: If set, only throttle when the playing item path contains this string (e.g. /mnt/user/nzbdav)
